The most appropriate ground is **Speech or Debate Clause immunity** (U.S. Const. art. I, §6, cl. 1), which gives members of Congress absolute protection for speech made in legislative activity, including floor speeches, so the suit fails regardless of the plaintiff's allegations about falsity or fault. The negligence-versus-actual-malice pleading gap is a weaker ground because it would only defeat the claim if the clause did not apply.

CONFIDENCE: 80
